description: Defines the SiteForCookies class used for determining same-site policies for cookies based on URL schemes and domains, including schemeful and schemeless policies, with methods for comparison, serialization, and first-party checks.

classes.name: SiteForCookies
classes.description: Represents a site for cookie policies, considering URL schemes and domains, with support for schemeful and schemeless policies, and methods for comparison, serialization, and first-party determination.

methods.name: FromWire
methods.description: Constructs a SiteForCookies instance from untrusted RPC values, returning success status.

methods.name: FromOrigin
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies matching URLs considered same-party as the given origin.

methods.name: FromUrl
methods.description: Creates a SiteForCookies from a URL, equivalent to FromOrigin with URL's origin.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the SiteForCookies object.

methods.name: IsFirstParty
methods.description: Checks if a URL is considered first-party to this site.

methods.name: IsFirstPartyWithSchemefulMode
methods.description: Checks first-party status with optional schemeful consideration.

methods.name: IsEquivalent
methods.description: Checks if another SiteForCookies is equivalent to this one.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeSiteAndRevise
methods.description: Revises the SiteForCookies based on frame tree origin, nullifying if not first-party.

methods.name: CompareWithFrameTreeOriginAndRevise
methods.description: Converts origin to SchemefulSite and compares/revises accordingly.

methods.name: RepresentativeUrl
methods.description: Returns a URL representative of this site for cookie purposes.

methods.name: scheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme of the site.

methods.name: registrable_domain
methods.description: Returns the registrable domain of the site.

methods.name: schemefully_same
methods.description: Indicates if the site is schemefully same.

methods.name: SetSchemefullySameForTesting
methods.description: Sets the schemefully_same flag for testing purposes.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Checks if the SiteForCookies matches nothing.
